commit.description: Commit the file changes that publish and sync make.

inbound.description: Whether and how this repository accepts friction reported by others.

allowFrom.description: Sender repositories, or `owner/*` globs, allowed to report friction here. Absent means anyone.

enabled.description: Accept friction reported by other repositories.

labels.description: Labels applied to inbound issues, in place of `labels`.
Labels applied to every issue this repository files about itself.

maxPerRun.description: Ceiling on issues filed in a single publish run, so a runaway agent cannot spray.

outbound.description: Where friction may be reported, and whether automation may do it unattended.

allowedRepos.description: Targets this repository may file against. Always read from the base branch, never a pull request head.

auto.description: Let the GitHub App file cross-repo without a human running publish. Off, because a private repository can leak proprietary detail upstream.

publishOnLog.description: Make `log` file the issue immediately, without needing `--publish`.

repo.description: `owner/name` this repository's own friction is filed against. Defaults to the origin remote.

severityLabels.description: Issue label applied for each severity.

sync.description: How local files reconcile against issue state.

closeOnDelete.description: Close the issue when its file is deleted by hand. Off, because a deletion is often just a rebase.
